description: Golden vectors for spec §13 type adapters. 'plan'/'expect' generated by the .NET reference (Rql.Conformance regen) and reviewed.

adapters.description: Test adapters every runtime registers (in its conformance harness) on a fresh engine over fixtures/cross-runtime/graph.json. Behaviour, not code, is specified here.

Vec2.encode: string "(x, y)" using shortest round-trip numbers, e.g. {x:2.25,y:3} -> "(2.25, 3)"
Vec2.coerce: from a string "(x, y)" (optional spaces) or a list [x, y] of two numbers; anything else fails with reason "expected (x, y) or [x, y]"; an object literal is NOT handled (NotHandled: defers to default construction, so {x: 3, y: 4} works)
Vec2.compare: equality: both values coerced to Vec2, equal when |dx| <= 1e-9 and |dy| <= 1e-9; ordering: by length sqrt(x*x+y*y)
Vec2.describe: Vec2: write as "(x, y)" or [x, y]

Node.members: virtual member `childCount` (int, read-only) = Children count; virtual writable member `title` (string): get = Name upper-cased (ASCII), set = Name := value lower-cased (ASCII); validation rejects an empty string with reason "title must not be empty" (before any write); the setter itself THROWS "node 3 is locked" when the node's Id is 3 (exercises rollback); member `Note` is HIDDEN; member `Children` is EXPLICIT-ONLY (generic recurse does not follow it); virtual map `stats` (map<string, number>): keys = Props keys in order, get = Props[key], set = Props[key] := value, validation rejects a key not in Props with reason "unknown stat '<key>'" and a negative value with "stats must be non-negative"; read-only virtual map `labels` (map<string, string>): keys "name", "kind" -> Name, Kind (enum name); virtual member `tagsCopy` (list<string>): get = a NEW copy of Tags, set = Tags := value, marked COPY-ON-READ; mixed-type virtual map `fields`: keys "Name", "Value", "Enabled" with entry types string / double / bool, get/set the corresponding member
Node.methods: callable `bump(number by = 1)`: Value += by, returns the new Value; its VALIDATOR rejects by < 0 with reason "by must be non-negative" and the node with Id 5 with "node 5 is frozen"; callable `greet(string who)`: returns "hi <who>, I am <Name>", no state change; callable `fail(string why)`: always THROWS with message <why> (call-threw)
Node.liveness: IsAlive = Tags does not contain "destroyed" (destroyed nodes read as null)

Special.members: virtual read-only member `powerLevel` (number) = Power / 1000 (applies IN ADDITION to the Node adapter: composition); display member is `title` (summaries show it as name)

engine.validateBatch: batch validator on every set / call stage (dry runs too): refuses a batch in which two `set` changes of member `Name` write the same string, reason "duplicate Name '<v>'"; refuses a batch whose `bump` calls' `by` arguments sum to more than 100, reason "bump total <sum> exceeds 100"; otherwise accepts

cases.name: adapt-encode-struct
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children | first 3 | select Name Pos

cases.name: adapt-virtual-readonly-member
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children | select Name Pos.len childCount

cases.name: adapt-virtual-member-filter
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children | where childCount > 0 | select Name childCount

cases.name: adapt-composition-subclass
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children | where $ is Special | select Name title powerLevel

cases.name: adapt-compare-coerced-equality
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children | where Pos == "(1, -1)" | select Name

cases.name: adapt-compare-list-equality
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children | where Pos == [10, 10] | select Name

cases.name: adapt-compare-ordering
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children | sort Pos desc | first 3 | select Name Pos.len

cases.name: adapt-mut-setter-throws-rolls-back
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children | first 3 | set title = "x"
cases.then: g.Nodes | recurse Children | first 3 | select Name

cases.name: adapt-explicit-only-generic-recurse
cases.rql: g | recurse | where $ is Node | select Name

types.name: Node

members.name: title
members.description: upper-cased Name; assigning sets Name lower-cased

members.name: fields
members.description: Name / Value / Enabled with per-key types

methods: bump(double by) — Value += by; returns the new Value
greet(string who) — a greeting (no state change)

cases.name: adapt-map-key-filter
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children | where stats["hp"] > 10 | select Name stats["hp"]

cases.name: adapt-dead-reads-null
cases.then: g | select missing=Nodes.any($ == null) names=Nodes.count() live=len(without(Nodes, null)) first=Nodes[2] t=Nodes[2].title

cases.name: adapt-display-member
cases.rql: g.Nodes | recurse Children | where $ is Special | select $

types.name: Vec2
types.description: Vec2: write as "(x, y)" or [x, y]

cases.name: adapt-entry-set-virtual-map
cases.rql: ref("Node#1") | get stats | where Key == "hp" | set Value = Value + 1
